title: HCGW19 5-round AES / aes-5r-id-property2-cc-hcgw2019

target.description: Five nonlinear AES rounds with whitening, omitted final MixColumns and included final AddRoundKey. Key-dependent subspaces are covered by exhaustive bin/indicator testing, not selected weak master keys.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key and its expanded round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen-ciphertext structures with eight intended active bytes; test each of sixteen (s,t) orientations and all 65536 tuples of the unknown whitening-key relations.
assumptions: The AES-bin existence property is deterministic; random-permutation error estimates use the source statistical approximations. No prior key-byte knowledge or related-key oracle.
setting.reference_model: Distinguish five-round AES under one unknown secret key from a random permutation with the same chosen-plaintext or chosen-ciphertext access; test all key-dependent bins without prior key knowledge.

time.note: Table 1/Section 4 headline. The text mentions O(2^n log(2^n)) sorting but reports only the leading 2^80.5 memory accesses; retain this author accounting, not an independently reconstructed total.

memory.note: One table for a ciphertext structure; indicator array is additional lower-order storage. No entry width is specified.

preprocessing.note: No numerical resource amount supplied for this endpoint.

success.description: Source calls the 5% random-permutation false acceptance a 95% success rate; the AES structural condition holds deterministically. Cross-orientation independence/union approximations are author assumptions.

evidence.interpretation: Targeted primary result statements and accounting checked; not a complete-paper proof audit.

field_conflicts.label: Ciphertext active-byte list
field_conflicts.description: The intended eight-byte structure is not consistently enumerated in Proposition 8.

observations.reported: Eight listed active positions repeat C[1,2], leaving seven distinct coordinates.
Each structure contains 2^64 ciphertexts (eight active bytes).

field_conflicts.label: Tuple indicator indexing
field_conflicts.description: Appendix pseudocode does not implement the two-component missing-tuple test stated in Proposition 8.

observations.reported: 65536 indicators, but update index uses only P[s,t] XOR P[s+1,t+1]; the sorted-coordinate list also misprints (s+2,s+2) instead of (s+2,t+2).
